name: Bellingen
aboutDesc: Brought to you by Bellingen Shire Council and supported through regional planning and environmental stewardship, Bellingen Shire is defined by its diverse landscapes on the Mid North Coast of New South Wales. It encompasses stunning coastline, the Bellinger and Kalang Rivers, and lush hinterland including Dorrigo National Park, fertile valleys, and vibrant local communities that support a strong small business and tourism economy.

name: Bellingen - Business
aboutDesc: Welcome to the Bellingen Shire Gift Card Business Hub. This dedicated platform is designed to provide participating businesses with all the essential information and resources you need to successfully promote and utilize the Bellingen Shire Gift Card.
